questions.text: Count out loud: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, ___. What number comes next?
questions.explanation: When counting by ones, the number after 9 is 10.

questions.text: There are 3 birds on a branch. 2 more birds fly over and land. How many birds are on the branch now?
questions.explanation: 3 + 2 = 5. Starting with 3 birds and adding 2 more gives 5 birds total.

questions.text: Start counting from 6. Which shows the next three numbers?
questions.explanation: Starting from 6, the next three numbers are 7, 8, 9.

questions.text: You have a pencil and a crayon. Which word describes how you could compare their sizes?
questions.explanation: Length is a measurable attribute. You can compare the pencil and crayon by measuring how long each one is.

questions.text: Look at these stars: ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ ★. How many stars are there?
questions.explanation: Counting each star one by one gives 7 stars total.

questions.text: Which shape has 3 sides and 3 corners?
questions.explanation: A triangle has exactly 3 sides and 3 corners, no matter what size or direction it faces.

questions.text: There are 6 dots on a card. How many dots are there?
questions.explanation: Counting each dot one by one gives 6 dots total.

questions.text: There are 4 frogs on a log. 2 frogs jump off. Which number sentence shows this story?
questions.explanation: Frogs jumping off means subtraction. 4 frogs minus 2 that jump off is written as 4 - 2.

questions.text: Group A has 3 dots. Group B has 5 dots. Which is true?
questions.explanation: Group A has 3 dots and Group B has 5 dots. 5 is greater than 3, so Group B has more.

questions.text: The number 14 is made of one group of ten and some ones. How many ones are left over?
questions.explanation: 14 = 1 ten + 4 ones. After taking one group of ten (10), there are 4 ones left.

questions.text: A ball is sitting on top of a box. Where is the ball?
questions.explanation: When something is on top of another object, it is above it.

questions.text: You have 3 red apples, 2 green apples, and 4 yellow bananas. How many pieces of fruit are apples?
questions.explanation: There are 3 red apples and 2 green apples. 3 + 2 = 5 apples total.

questions.text: Count by tens: 10, 20, 30, ___, 50. What number is missing?
questions.explanation: When counting by tens, the number after 30 is 40.

questions.text: A circle and a square are both flat shapes. How are they different?
options: The circle has straight sides and the square does not
The square has straight sides and the circle does not
questions.explanation: A square has 4 straight sides and 4 corners. A circle has no straight sides and no corners — it is perfectly round.
